statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The monitoring is to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on Coordination of Benefits protocols indicating care may be covered by another payer
The insurer is the secondary payer
